title: chore(deps): upgrade @objectstack/* from ^3.2.5 to ^3.2.6
body:
Bump all `@objectstack/*` packages to latest v3.2.6 across the monorepo.

- **43 version references** updated in 13 `package.json` files (root, apps/console, examples/*, packages/*)
- **Lockfile** regenerated
- **CHANGELOG.md** updated

Packages upgraded: `cli`, `client`, `core`, `driver-memory`, `objectql`, `plugin-auth`, `plugin-hono-server`, `plugin-msw`, `runtime`, `spec`, `studio`.

No breaking changes. Build (42 tasks) and test suite (7,119 tests) pass. One pre-existing test failure in `RelatedList.test.tsx` is unrelated.
